The '''E-1 Enforcer blaster''' was a model of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used<ref name="Cartel Market" /> around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|5.9}}</ref> E-1 Enforcer blasters were used by Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Medic/Legends|medics]] during the [[mission to Mek-Sha]].<ref name="TOR:DtD">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Defending the Docks|Mek-Sha}}</ref>
